svg.title: Blue Red
svg.desc: Interpretive study after a visually inspected primary museum photograph. Approximate geometry; interpretive screen colours. Observed blue-left/red-right bow-tie outline, not a rectangular two-colour field. Joined seam and proportions approximate; no white background painted into the SVG. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of red, blue; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Reference: https://www.thebroad.org/art/ellsworth-kelly/blue-red; object B-KELLY-2P87.06; reviewed 2026-10-27; not a facsimile.
